observable: Calibration drift of the pressure sensor (measured in units of pressure over time)
baseline: Calibration drift of the same pressure sensor without the low-temperature annealing chamber
expected_magnitude: 30% reduction over a period of 30 days
conditions: The device is operated under a constant pressure of 1000 mbar, with the low-temperature annealing chamber set to apply a thermal treatment every 24 hours for 1 hour at a temperature of 150°C.
falsifier: If the calibration drift of the pressure sensor with the low-temperature annealing chamber is not significantly lower than the calibration drift of the same pressure sensor without the low-temperature annealing chamber after 30 days of operation, the prediction is falsified.
